# Understanding generative AI and its applications


For example, SoundHound AI Inc. and Qualcomm Technologies are collaborating on the Snapdragon Digital Chassis concept vehicle to showcase the benefits of generative AI integration via the incorporation of SoundHound Chat AI for Automotive. By utilizing this platform, both passengers and drivers can pose virtually any inquiry and obtain a reply from a system that arbitrates intelligently to prioritize the most pertinent information from over 100 domains of knowledge.
